subject.title: [Feature]: Thread replies when agent uses tools; top-level for conversational responses

question: Should Slack add a default-off tool-use-sensitive reply policy, and what precedence should it have relative to existing replyToMode controls, DMs/group DMs, existing threads, explicit top-level opt-outs, streaming previews, and status indicators?
rationale: Current source proves the feature is absent, but adding the proposed config changes compatibility-sensitive Slack delivery behavior and needs product-owned precedence rules before implementation.

options.title: Approve Precise Slack Policy
options.body: Define the config shape and precedence, then implement the Slack-owned schema, routing, docs, and tests path with default false for existing installs.

options.title: Use Static Reply Controls Only
options.body: Treat account, chat-type, and per-channel replyToMode as the supported solution for channel cleanliness and close or deprioritize this feature direction.

options.title: Defer To Cross-Channel Policy
options.body: Hold this issue until maintainers design a broader reply-placement policy that can cover Slack without one-off config drift.

recommendation.title: Approve Precise Slack Policy
recommendation.body: Define the config shape and precedence, then implement the Slack-owned schema, routing, docs, and tests path with default false for existing installs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on Slack reply-mode config and merged the closest related routing/config PR.
